visualCharacteristics.layout: vertical contact directory, centred ~1060px column, text left aligned; each group: bold heading with a thin grey rule under it, then phone number (larger text) on the left and details on the right (stacks on mobile); generous spacing between groups
visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: dark text on white, grey rules

optionLayouts.grid: light-grey filled tiles, 3 per row from 900px (2 from 600px, 1 below); bold heading with phone and email stacked under it in small text; no rules

contentPattern.structure: one row per contact group, 3 cells: [H3 group heading] | [phone (tel: link), may be empty] | [details: address lines, links, email]
